info.title: graphwing
info.description: Local node catalog for Rewst Graph. Deterministic git/gh/file/units/herdr/stack/port plus allowlisted scripts and tests. rrRun is an optional plugin when rr.json is present. One-job agent loops return 202 + job_id; completion POSTs an artifact receipt to response_webhook_url (action.wait.webhook). Cloud GitHub/Shortcut stay Rewst integrations. PR driver is a Graph of these nodes, not one agentRun. Public server URL is written by named-tunnel setup (cloudflared-meta.json) or GRAPHWING_PUBLIC_URL; catalog default is loopback.

post.summary: Mark a ticket done in the index file. Does not commit. Ticket keys beyond the core five (class, size, ac_count, seams, build_id, verification) survive the rewrite.
Fire a Rewst webhook trigger. This host holds the trigger URL and shared secret, so the caller never needs the webhook key.
Deterministic class×size lookup: launcher, model, turns, budget, opposing reviewers. Never picks a vendor because tests were red.
After the map is empty: run a named tests.json recipe. Green or skip ends. Fail auto-adds a ticket from FAIL: lines, drafts if the log is a blob, parks after 3 reds.
Opposing-vendor spec-review of git diff HEAD. Plan-mode Claude for sonnet/opus; Hermes for sol. Does not commit.
After a slice push: if the next frontier ticket is build and kick_url is set, POST that webhook with the next ticket path. Serial walker. https kick_url only.

Open a versioned pre-PR build under $GRAPHWING_HOME and return its build_id, stage, and next allowed action. Re-posting the same build_id with identical input returns the existing build (created=false); different input is an idempotency conflict.

Apply one durable transition. event_id makes it idempotent: same id + same payload replays the receipt, same id + different payload is 409 idempotency_conflict. holder takes a lease so a second Rewst run cannot advance the same build until it expires. A head, worktree, or state-version the build cannot explain parks it with a named reason.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

add.description: Relative paths to git add before commit, or a single path string. Omitted: commit already-staged files only. No .. or absolute paths. Default does not add -A.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name, not a filesystem path.

remote.description: Named remote already on the repo. Not a URL. Not --force.

ref.description: HEAD if omitted. No +, no :, no delete, no force.

name.description: scripts.json name only. No client argv.

response_webhook_url.description: https URL from action.wait.webhook pending.resumeUrl. Used when the script is async.

response_webhook_token.description: From action.wait.webhook pending.resumeToken. Sent as X-Rewst-Token on the callback.

compact.description: Short test/script failure signal for a resume prompt. 'ok' when the recipe passed. Never the full log.

kick_url.description: https Rewst webhook to start the next slice. Omitted: return frontier only.

test.description: tests.json name. Omitted or empty: skip.

BuildVerification.description: Verification the plan declared for this build. Names are tests.json recipes.

needs_visual_proof.description: False skips the evidence stage: verify_passed goes straight to review.

build_id.description: Caller-chosen id, 8-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._-]. Required: the caller is the only party that can repeat it, so a generated id would turn every timed-out retry into a second build with its own lease and budget.

story.description: Rejected with secret_in_story if it carries a credential: identity fields are refused, not redacted.

repo.description: Allowlisted short name. The build's worktree identity is that repo's path.

head.description: Git object id the build starts from.

worktree.description: Optional assertion; must equal the allowlisted repo path.

index.description: Optional: omit the key for no index. When present it must be a non-empty repo-relative path of at most 256 characters (BUILD_NAME_MAX), because a later stage opens it inside the build's worktree. null, an empty string, and a non-string are refused with bad_index rather than folded into absent. The service additionally refuses an absolute path, a leading ~, a backslash, and any '..' segment; that rule is enforced server-side, not by this schema.

ticket.description: Optional: omit the key for no ticket. When present it must be a non-empty repo-relative path of at most 256 characters (BUILD_NAME_MAX), because a later stage opens it inside the build's worktree. null, an empty string, and a non-string are refused with bad_ticket rather than folded into absent. The service additionally refuses an absolute path, a leading ~, a backslash, and any '..' segment; that rule is enforced server-side, not by this schema.

route.description: sliceRoute row: launcher, model, reviewers, turns.

event_id.description: Names one requested transition. Reuse it to retry safely.

holder.description: Lease owner, normally the Rewst run id. Rejected with secret_in_holder if it carries a credential: redacting it would make two callers compare equal and share a lease.

release_lease.description: Drop the lease after this transition instead of holding it.

jobs_spent.description: Default 1, or 0 for park. Overrunning jobs_max parks the build.

expect.description: Guards. A mismatch parks the build rather than guessing.

head.description: Optional. Compared to the live worktree HEAD, never to the stored document.

branch.description: Optional plain ref name. Compared to the branch the allowlisted checkout is live on, not to the branch recorded on the build; a mismatch parks with branch_mismatch. Rejected with bad_expect_branch if it is not a plain ref name.

worktree.description: Optional assertion; compared to the worktree the build was opened on.

data.description: Transition payload. Secret-shaped keys and values are redacted before the write. Branch and head identity come from the live Git read of the allowlisted checkout, so no payload field can move them: a data.head is ignored. Unknown keys are dropped. The fields that fold into state are writer_session (a gwslice-<32 hex> session id, bound by start_writer only), stacks, review (review_passed), round (evidence_captured), pr (pr_opened), and reason/detail (park).

event_count.description: Event ids this build will never accept a second time. Receipts age out; this count does not.

event_capacity.description: Ceiling on event_count. Reaching it is 409 event_history_full, not an eviction.

created.description: buildCreate only. False when the build already existed.

replayed.description: buildAdvance only. True when the event_id had already run.

auto_merge.description: Off unless this run was started with auto-merge

run_id.description: Merge is only reachable from inside a run

merge_method.description: Not named `method`: the connector reads that as the HTTP verb.

kick_url.description: https Rewst webhook for the next attempt

all_green.description: ghPrChecks: no fail and no pending

profile.description: Seat from profiles.json. v0.4 executes graphwing home only. Listed runnable=false seats return 400.

hermes_session.description: Named Hermes session gwslice-<32 hex>. Omit to mint one. Retry passes the receipt value to resume the same session.

cwd.description: Allowlisted repo short name, not a filesystem path.

response_webhook_url.description: https URL from action.wait.webhook pending.resumeUrl. POSTed the bounded receipt when the job finishes.

response_webhook_token.description: From action.wait.webhook pending.resumeToken. Sent as X-Rewst-Token on the callback. Default wait-webhook auth is token.
